statement: Between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-31, the governments of the United States and Iran both publicly commit to a ceasefire or cessation of hostilities between the two countries.
resolution: TRUE if, between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-31, the US President or White House and the Iranian government each publicly confirm a US-Iran ceasefire or cessation of hostilities, as reported by Reuters or AP.
failure_condition: The United States and Iran do not both publicly commit to a ceasefire or cessation of hostilities at any point between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-31.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-29, at least one merchant vessel is attacked or seized by armed forces or armed attackers in the Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz, or Gulf of Oman.
resolution: TRUE if UKMTO reports a merchant vessel struck by projectile, drone, mine, or explosive, fired upon, or seized in the Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz, or Gulf of Oman, with an incident date between 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-29.
failure_condition: No merchant vessel is attacked or seized in the Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz, or Gulf of Oman on any date between 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-29.

statement: Between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15, at least one NATO member state formally requests consultations under Article 4 of the North Atlantic Treaty.
resolution: TRUE if NATO or the requesting government publicly confirms a formal Article 4 consultation request made between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No NATO member state makes a formal Article 4 consultation request between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15.

statement: The EIA Cushing WTI crude spot price (FRED series DCOILWTICO) is at or below 90.00 dollars per barrel on at least one observation date between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-30. Reference: WTI 104.64 dollars per barrel in the 2026-09-15 packet market snapshot.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DCOILWTICO shows a daily value at or below 90.00 for any observation date between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-30; otherwise FALSE. Reference: 104.64 on 2026-09-15.
failure_condition: The WTI Cushing spot price stays above 90.00 dollars per barrel on every observation date from 2026-09-16 through 2026-10-30.
